had no idea she could run like that.

Oaks. Anyone who can do that's gotta be strong.

text_block_list.text: I guess runn'n well's all I have to worry about.

text_block_list.text: I must've looked pretty conf'dent out there!

text_block_list.text:
Yukino is such a cutie. With looks like that,
she's just gonna get more and more popular from
here.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, did you see the plushie they just
released? I've gotta get me one!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for sure! We should bring them to her next
race too! I'm on this hype train to all the way!

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win the Shuka Sho!
